chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Abdullah, al-Ja'fari. Narrated from him is Ali ibn Muhammad al-Ubaydi, the Sahib of the Zanj in Basra, and narrated from him is Ammarah ibn Zaid - also - and he is one whose hadith is denied.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الزَّجْجِ: Sahib of the Zanj (referring to Ali ibn Muhammad, a companion of the Zanj rebellion leader)
key_terms.مَنْكَرُ الْحَدِيثِ: Mankar al-hadith (one whose hadith is denied or considered weak/unreliable)

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Ja'fari and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the Kitab al-Du'afa (Book of the Weak/Declared Unreliable) concerning Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Abdullah al-Ja'fari. It notes that he was narrated from by Ali ibn Muhammad al-Ubaydi (Sahib al-Zanj) in Basra and by Ammarah ibn Zayd, and concludes that he is considered 'mankar al-hadith' (one whose hadith is denied/unreliable).
